title: 3+1 Physique Protocol
author: Anthony Jackson
desc: Unlock your potential with the 3+1 Physique Protocol, a dynamic 6-week program designed for intermediate lifters. Committing just 4 days a week, you'll engage in 60-minute sessions that focus on building muscle and sculpting your physique. Utilizing a full gym setup, this program combines targeted strength training with strategic recovery, ensuring you maximize gains while minimizing burnout. Get ready to transform your body and elevate your fitness journey!
